candidate.explanation_ar: لما تكون بتأكد على كلامك بقوة ووضوح عشان محدش يشك فيه.

senses.definition_en: Expressing something forcibly and clearly; decisive and unambiguous.
senses.explanation_ar: التعبير عن الرأي أو الموقف بقوة وحسم لا يدع مجالاً للشك، أو وصف أمر بأنه قاطع وحاسم.
examples: The team won an emphatic victory.
She was emphatic that she would not go.
His denial of the allegations was immediate and emphatic.
The team won an emphatic victory.
She was emphatic that she would not go.
His denial of the allegations was immediate and emphatic.
candidate.mnemonic: جاية من 'Emphasis' 'تأكيد'.. لما تكون 'Emphatic' بتبقى بتعمل 'Emphasis' جامد.
